name: rustc
description: The Rust compiler. Cross-compiles to aarch64-linux-android when the target standard library is installed.
limitations: Termux ships rustc as a package; rustup is not the default there
proc-macro crates must compile for the host
Some crates require a C toolchain for build scripts

name: Cargo
description: Rust package manager and build driver. Handles dependency resolution, feature flags, profiles and cross-target builds.
requirements: Optional .cargo/config.toml for linker and target settings
limitations: Registry access is needed for non-vendored dependencies
Build scripts run on the host, not the target
Offline builds require a vendored or cached registry

name: aarch64-linux-android target
description: Rust target for 64-bit Android on ARM. Standard library builds are distributed; linking requires the Android NDK clang wrapper.
requirements: minSdkVersion matching the linker API level
limitations: Tier 2: no automated CI guarantee for the target
Bionic-specific APIs differ from glibc
Some crates do not support the target

name: cargo-ndk
description: Cargo subcommand that configures Android NDK linkers and packages .so files for one or more ABIs. The standard way to build a Rust library for Android.
limitations: Needs a full NDK; ndk-sysroot alone is not enough
Does not package an APK by itself
Version drift between cargo-ndk and NDK releases

name: wgpu
description: Rust implementation of WebGPU that runs on Vulkan, Metal, Direct3D 12 and OpenGL ES. The default renderer for Bevy and many Rust game projects.
requirements: Vulkan backend for the full feature set on Android
Surface created from an Android window via android-activity
limitations: GLES backend is a fallback with fewer features
Shader translation through naga adds build time
Some WebGPU features are optional per adapter

name: winit
description: Cross-platform window and event loop crate. On Android it integrates with the native activity lifecycle through android-activity.
limitations: Android lifecycle events must be handled explicitly
Suspend/resume destroys the surface on many devices
Input mapping from touch to game controls is the app's job

name: ash
description: Thin Rust bindings to Vulkan. Low overhead, unsafe API surface, full control over the Vulkan objects.
limitations: No safety wrapper; lifetime bugs are UB
Requires manual extension loading
macOS needs MoltenVK

name: glow
description: Rust bindings for OpenGL and OpenGL ES with runtime function loading. Works on Android through EGL.
limitations: GLES feature set only on Android
No compute shaders before GLES 3.1
Driver-specific GLSL quirks

name: jni crate
description: Rust bindings for the Java Native Interface, including JNIEnv, JObject and string conversion. Used to expose a Rust core to an Android Activity.
requirements: jni crate with the appropriate features
JNIEXPORT symbols matching the Java package and class
limitations: Unsafe reference handling
Thread attachment required
Signature strings must match Java exactly

name: ndk crate
description: Rust wrappers for the Android NDK: native activity, asset manager, input queue, audio and configuration APIs.
requirements: NDK headers and libs at build time
limitations: Android-only crate; host builds need cfg gates
API coverage lags the NDK
Some modules are behind features

name: android-activity
description: Rust glue for the Android activity lifecycle, used by winit and Bevy. Handles NativeActivity, input queue and surface lifetime.
requirements: NativeActivity or a custom Activity with the right manifest entries
limitations: Game loop must handle pause/resume and surface loss
Threading model differs from desktop
Debugging needs logcat

name: oboe-rs
description: Rust bindings for Oboe, Google's low-latency Android audio library built on AAudio and OpenSL ES.
limitations: Requires a C++ toolchain for the Oboe sources
Callback runs on a real-time thread
Device-specific latency varies
